system.description:
You weave Wind Release Chakra together, creating a thin veil of chakra in the shape of a Lion around you and other creatures of your choice in range. This chakra then collapses on the group granting all select creatures the listed benefits of the duration;

Bonus +15 feet to speed.

A rank of Mastery for Ninjutsu Attack Rolls.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the bonus to speed to +25. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, all affected creatures deal a bonus +1d8 to damage they deal as a result of jutsu they cast, twice per turn. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, Ninjutsu attack rolls instead gain 2 ranks of Mastery. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, all affected creatures gain Immunity to the Dazed and Weakened conditions.
